observations: Continues the final question of scan314 as extension of algebraically trivial invertible modules from the generic fibre over a trait, with an insertion requiring algebraic triviality on the special fibre.

Representability is cited as sufficient and available in the projective case; the attribution d’après Raynaud is struck out. The last question asks whether representability holds for proper flat families with geometrically normal, or merely integral, fibres.
